role: Exploratory development after native signal diagnosis; no independent test or new confirmation
baseline: Original selected expanded EMER checkpoints; frozen, never reselected
correction_features: Seven candidate-centered within-slate ranks; hate oriented to no-hate; identical construction in both learned arms
fit: Weighted long-view positive-negative pair logistic loss on the 30000 training slates only; fixed frozen baseline score divided by its per-slate standard deviation, plus bounded tanh correction
selection: Each learned arm independently maximizes validation long-view NDCG@3 subject to guards against original frozen EMER; zero candidate first, strict improvements only, earlier ridge wins ties
acceptance_for_new_test_planning: Jev beats both original frozen EMER and equal-capacity behavior correction on all five original descriptive development gates; this permits planning only and is not confirmatory success
